data.title: 小岭幸 · 睡前走廊的热可可送达
data.description: 熄灯前的宿舍走廊静悄悄的，小岭幸套着软乎乎的浅蓝鲨鱼连体睡衣，踩着毛绒拖鞋轻手轻脚停在门前。她双手稳稳托着一盘两杯热可可与小饼干，认真汇报「睡前补给已送达」，柔软的毛绒袖口让整个人显得格外软糯。
data.location: 点着壁灯的深夜美浜宿舍木走廊
data.action: 穿着鲨鱼连体睡衣双手稳托热可可托盘停步微笑
data.lighting: 走廊复古壁灯投下的温馨暖黄光晕
data.camera: 平视中全身，凸显宽大鲨鱼连体服与毛绒拖鞋的可爱轮廓
data.mood: 软萌、贴心、令人会心一笑
data.promptProse: Pausing outside a bedroom door in the softly lit wooden dormitory hallway, Sachi Komine balances a small tray holding two steaming mugs of cocoa and biscuits. Her oversized pastel-blue plush shark onesie and slippers soften her dutiful posture into an irresistibly cozy late-night visit.
data.animaCaption: Standing in the dimly lit dorm hallway in her plush shark onesie, she carefully presents a tray of hot cocoa.
